FEAT-1-STORY-9.title: Define Provider Search Request/Response Schema
FEAT-1-STORY-9.description: Formalize Pydantic models for provider search input (query, location, filters) and standardized response payload (provider list, scores, metadata) to ensure contract consistency across facade and domain layers.

FEAT-1-STORY-10.title: Implement Location Filtering and FIPS Mapping Logic
FEAT-1-STORY-10.description: Enhance provider search core logic to enforce location filtering using ZIP/FIPS-to-county mapping and ensure accurate narrowing of results by state, city, and county hierarchy.

FEAT-1-STORY-11.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCare Facade
FEAT-1-STORY-11.description: Integrate provider search service into find_care_facade with a callable method that orchestrates specialty detection, search execution, and response formatting for tool_router consumption.

FEAT-1-STORY-12.title: Add Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Search
FEAT-1-STORY-12.description: Create unit tests for provider_search_service (vector + taxonomy fallback, location filtering) and integration tests through facade/tool_router to validate end-to-end behavior.

FEAT-1-STORY-13.title: Tool Router Integration for Provider Search
FEAT-1-STORY-13.description: Register provider search as an allowlisted tool in tool_router with validated input handling and proper routing to the FindCare facade, ensuring compliance with GOV-004 tool dispatch rules.
